fixed_decisions.contract: Remote role content, prompt alias, optional model override, and text/plain role bodies remain supported.
Existing safe HTTP endpoints and Teams, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp routing remain available through Rust compatibility shims.
The final product never evaluates legacy executeCode JavaScript.
The migration command emits a signed-WASI manifest and WIT scaffold, reports recognized httpGet/httpPost/log bridge use, and exits nonzero while any JavaScript remains.

deliberate_breaking_changes.legacy_behavior: Remote executeCode is evaluated by isolated-vm or node:vm.
deliberate_breaking_changes.rust_behavior: No JavaScript engine is present; generated WASI/WIT scaffolds require an explicit Rust port and signature before activation.
deliberate_breaking_changes.reason: Remove arbitrary remote code execution from the final trust boundary.

deliberate_breaking_changes.legacy_behavior: AUTO_UPDATE may run npm update and the Copilot CLI curl installer inside the process environment.
deliberate_breaking_changes.rust_behavior: Compatibility reports update availability; installation is limited to a separately verified signed release workflow.
deliberate_breaking_changes.reason: A pure Rust artifact has no Node package graph and must not mutate itself through unsigned package-manager or shell pipelines.

evidence_gaps.detail: Exact Bot Framework authentication and wire responses are delegated to botbuilder and have no repository-owned protocol tests.
evidence_gaps.required_follow_up: Capture sanitized Bot Framework request/response traces before replacing botbuilder.

evidence_gaps.detail: Copilot SDK session event shapes, reconnect behavior, and model-specific errors are external and unpinned beyond package-lock.
evidence_gaps.required_follow_up: Record SDK contract tests against the locked dependency and representative models.

evidence_gaps.detail: No live Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, or Teams fixtures exist in the repository.
evidence_gaps.required_follow_up: Capture sanitized provider payloads and failure responses before removing the TypeScript runtime.

evidence_gaps.detail: run.sh behavior is not tested across Docker versions, architectures, rootless mode, or non-Linux hosts.
evidence_gaps.required_follow_up: Execute the deployment acceptance matrix on supported Linux targets.

evidence_gaps.detail: Whitelisted command output varies by host utilities and Docker versions.
evidence_gaps.required_follow_up: Treat output as opaque text and add host-specific snapshots only where compatibility requires them.
